sentences.en: The new law has deprived the citizens of their liberty.
sentences.zh: 新法律剥夺了市民的自由。

sentences.en: Several thousand people were deprived of transportation by the accident.
sentences.zh: 事故使数千人失去了交通工具。

sentences.en: Those black people have long been deprived of their rights.
sentences.zh: 那些黑人民权被长期剥夺已久。
